structure.rule: subject -> unit -> chapter. A unit is NTA's 'UNIT n'. NTA does not divide its JEE units into chapters, so each unit has exactly one chapter with the same name. Chemistry's 'group' is NTA's own Physical/Inorganic/Organic heading. Nothing here is grouped or split beyond what the PDF prints.
structure.name: NTA's wording, re-cased for display; name_verbatim is exactly as printed.
structure.weight: Not recorded. Chapter weights will be counted from past papers, not estimated.

ncert.edition: Rationalised textbooks, 'Reprint 2026-27' (printed on every page of the files checked)
ncert.how_verified: Every chapter number, title and PDF link was checked by downloading the chapter PDF from ncert.nic.in on 2026-10-07 and reading its opening page: the printed heading for 104 of the 106 files; for keph107 (Gravitation) and lech104 (d- and f-Block) the heading is an image, so the opening text was read instead. File checksums and headings: data/raw/syllabus/ncert/chapter_pdf_check.tsv; book contents pages: data/raw/syllabus/ncert/*ps.pdf.
ncert.shape: ncert_ref is null (no counterpart) or a list of {class, subject, book, chapter, title, pdf[, sections]}. 'sections' is present only when a syllabus chapter maps to part of an NCERT chapter. NCERT Chemistry calls its chapters 'Unit n'; 'chapter' holds that n.

ambiguities.what: Headings are printed 'INTEGRAL CALCULAS' and 'DIFFRENTIAL EQUATIONS'. Display names correct the spelling; name_verbatim keeps the print.

The integral forms ('integrals of the type ...') and the differential-equation form are images; the PDF's text layer does not contain them. Irrelevant at chapter level; read the page image if the exact forms are ever needed.
Numbered 'UNIT I' (Roman) while every other unit is Arabic. Treated as Unit 1.
'Co-ordinate Geometry' is one unit containing NTA's own sub-headings 'Straight line' and 'Circle, conic sections'. Kept as one chapter; not split.
'Optics' is one unit covering ray optics and (sub-heading) 'Wave optics'. Kept as one chapter; the NCERT link lists both NCERT chapters.
